text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm pulling together the evidence bundle for Brightline's onboarding SLA report. Two quick asks: (1) when we share latency with customers, do we present p95 or p99? (2) preferred uptime ledger format: CSV or a one-page PDF summary? cc @Kevin @Sophia

Kevin Patel: For customer-facing summaries we usually show p95. Include a footnote that internal metrics are p99 for credit calculations. CSV is fine — easier for their analysts to ingest.

Sophia Rivera: +1 csv. Also include the timeframe we used (30d rolling) and timezone (UTC). Customers keep asking about bucket alignment.

Maria Chen: Got it. So: p95 in the summary, p99 in the credit calc appendix. 30d rolling, UTC. Thanks.

Drew Liu: Adding ops note — when you export the uptime ledger from the observability UI, select "Export > CSV (detailed)" and include the header row. Also attach the audit log for any maintenance windows.

Maria Chen: Helpful — can you paste the quick export command? Trying to automate the bundle generation.

Drew Liu: Sure — from the infra box we run:

```
# quick export of uptime windows for customer
rbx-observability export --customer brightline --range 30d --format csv --include-maintenance > brightline-uptime-30d.csv
```

Drew Liu: And we timestamp the bundle at creation: `bundle_created_$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).zip`

Maria Chen: Perfect. I'll wire that into the onboarding template.

Kevin Patel: One more: for the credit calc appendix include a small table showing thresholds and the resulting credit. Example: 

```
Latency threshold | Window | Credit
p95 < 300ms      | 30d    | 0% 
p95 300-500ms    | 30d    | 5% 
p95 > 500ms      | 30d    | 10%
```

Maria Chen: Nice. I'll draft the appendix and post the bundle in the shared drive.

ops-bot: automated: report upload succeeded: /shared/brightline/onboarding/sla_evidence/brightline-bundle-20240312.zip :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: Uploaded and shared with customer. Sending handoff to AE for renewal-readiness note. @Kevin anything you want included before I close the thread?

Kevin Patel: Maybe one line about expected noise during the onboarding ramp (first 72 hours). Otherwise good to close. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Added the 72-hour ramp note and closed the bundle. Thanks all.
